title: Seoul Has the World's 'Coolest' Neighborhood
paragraphs: Every year, the travel and entertainment magazine Time Out makes a list of the coolest neighborhoods in the world. In 2026, the top neighborhood is in Seoul, the capital of South Korea.

The list was published on September 16, 2026, and it includes 40 neighborhoods. Jongno 3-ga, in the center of Seoul, was first. The area was third on the list in 2021. To make the list, Time Out's local experts around the world chose neighborhoods that are good for eating, drinking, shopping and spending time. Then, a group of editors checked each one. They looked at things like nightlife, independent businesses, how nice the area is to live in and its community.

According to Time Out, the area is becoming popular again because of its pochas. These are street food stalls with orange tents that are open late at night. In the past, they sold cheap and fast food to workers. Now, many young people come to sit on the plastic stools because the food is cheap and the atmosphere is relaxed. People can eat dishes such as pajeon, a Korean pancake with kimchi and seafood, grilled eel, squid and even live octopus.

There are many other interesting places in Jongno 3-ga. Ikseon-dong has traditional wooden houses that are about 100 years old, and they are very popular on social media. There is also a street with jewelry shops, art workshops and wine bars next to the old stone walls of Jongmyo Shrine. In addition, there is a large music market from the 1960s with hundreds of shops. People also come to the area to drink makgeolli, a Korean rice wine. And in autumn, the leaves of the tall ginkgo trees turn gold and cover the streets.
Other neighborhoods in the top six were in Rabat, Athens, Los Angeles, Glasgow and Osaka.
